name: lingjing-platform
description: 灵创社区平台 — 统一启动入口

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors "blue,green" --names "backend,frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
